simple.summary: חוּר (chûwr) means white linen First listed occurrence: Esth 1 6.

definitions.full: H2353. chur I. חוּר noun [masculine] white stuff (dubious whether cotton or linen, compare כַּרְמַּס ), || תְּכֵלֶת : — of Mordecai's garments וָחוּר תְּכֵלֶת מַלְכוּת בִּלְבוּשׁ Est 8:15 a in a royal garment of violet and white stuff (compare וְאַרְגָּמָן בּוּץ וְתַכְרִיךְ v b ); of furnishings of royal palace of Susa וְאַרְגָּמָן ׳ח בְּחַבְלֵיבֿוּץ אֶחוּז וּתְכֵלֶת כַּרְמַּס 1:6 white stuff of fine linen (?) held fast by cords of byssus and purple.
